requirements.name: years of experience
requirements.source: - 1 to 3 years of experience in application security, software engineering or a related role; security internships and graduate research count toward this.

requirements.name: OWASP Top 10
requirements.source: - Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web and API vulnerability classes.

requirements.name: threat modeling
requirements.source: - Hands-on experience with threat modeling (STRIDE or similar).

requirements.name: code review languages
requirements.source: - Experience reviewing code for security issues in at least one of Python, Java or Go.

requirements.name: web testing tools
requirements.source: - Familiarity with web testing tools such as Burp Suite.

requirements.name: vulnerability triage
requirements.source: - Experience triaging vulnerabilities and working with engineers to get them fixed.

requirements.name: degree
requirements.source: - Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent experience.

requirements.name: threat modeling sessions
requirements.source: - Lead threat modeling sessions for new features and services, and turn the results into concrete engineering tickets.

requirements.name: PR and design review
requirements.source: - Review pull requests and design documents for injection, authentication, authorization and data exposure flaws.

requirements.name: API security testing
requirements.source: - Test our REST and GraphQL APIs for broken access control and business-logic issues, and help teams fix what you find.

requirements.name: static analysis and dependency scanning
requirements.source: - Run and tune our static analysis (Semgrep) and dependency scanning in CI, writing custom rules for patterns specific to our codebase.

requirements.name: bug bounty and pentest triage
requirements.source: - Triage findings from scanners, our bug bounty program and penetration tests, assign severity, and track remediation to closure.

requirements.name: secure coding libraries
requirements.source: - Contribute to secure-by-default libraries and guidance for our Python and Java services.

requirements.name: AWS security architecture
requirements.source: - Take part in security architecture reviews for changes to our AWS environment.

requirements.name: Semgrep or CodeQL rules
requirements.source: - Experience writing Semgrep or CodeQL rules.

requirements.name: AWS cloud security
requirements.source: - Exposure to cloud security on AWS (IAM, network controls, logging).

requirements.name: regulated environment
requirements.source: - Experience in a regulated environment such as healthcare (HIPAA) or payments (PCI DSS).

requirements.name: certifications
requirements.source: - Relevant certifications such as OSCP or GWAPT.
